about: The condition line attributes parkinsonism to risperidone and identifies it as the reason for the Sifrol supplies.
Possible finding: the first ropinirole supply follows haloperidol, but the record does not say whether ropinirole treats antipsychotic movement side effects or drug-induced parkinsonism.
The discharge letter records drug-induced parkinsonism, and L002 identifies Parkinson disease as the sole reason for Madopar.
